Prior NATIVE_TAIL_V01 and ELIGIBILITY_V01 used a pinned raw reader after fresh memory descent; their accepted native scope is retained, but they do not establish the ordinary TaskStore reader seam.
New source uses the existing typed inert ordinary producer only offline. No synthetic role result is an owner model boundary or real provider response.
Original ORDINARY_V02 primary reason remains UNKNOWN. A new ordinary-reader result may identify its own cause but cannot reconstruct the old lost exception.
Explicit history-only evaluation clocks do not assert wall-time aging or renew original TTL/valid_to. Conflict/quarantine remain restrictions and expired history is not opened.
All v01 actuals, reviews, pins, failed runs and reservation remain untouched. No model, AUTH, E, SAVE, public push or owner actual was run in preparing this matrix.
COMPLETION_V03 adds only its independently accepted ordinary-prefix and cold G3 credit. It stopped at G4_TASK_ROOT and does not satisfy the three new gaps or G4 continuation.

The observed V03 projected code is SANITIZED_OPERATION_FAILURE. Source review establishes observation-time comparison and negative Root-reason defects; exact original operands and exception text were not recorded.

TASKSTORE_SEAM_V02 retained independently accepted ordinary-reader G3/G4 and aged current-Work witnesses before its second task failed. Its exact total wall time and within-900 finalization are not established. The original inner exception was not retained.
The remaining native source-revision and unrelated-task checks must use fresh authority. The expired V02 DocumentMemory record and prior live bindings are never revived.
This draft maps independently reviewed partial evidence. It does not grant execution, owner readiness, Stage05 closure, or publication.

The proposed remainder source-revision refusal uses the fresh unrelated cold binding. The owner scenario still owes the Rowan qualified-binding revision observation after dependent consumers.
